issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מַלְאָכִים' means 'messengers' (plural of 'מַלְאָךְ'), not 'angels' (which is also 'מַלְאָכִים' in Hebrew but contextually here it is clearly 'messengers' as David is sending people to a human king). The Chinese '天使' specifically means 'angel' (a supernatural being), which would mislead a Chinese reader into thinking David sent divine beings rather than human envoys.
